title: Skin Care for Kochi Weather: A Light Routine for Humidity and Two Monsoons
ex: Humid almost all year, two rainy seasons and hot, sticky summers: a light, simple skin care routine for people living in Kochi.
rt: Skin Care for Kochi Weather: Humid-Climate Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Kochi weather: light layers for humid air, sunscreen on rainy days, monsoon hygiene, heat rash tips, coconut oil and AC offices, kept simple.
quick: Kochi is humid for most of the year, with two rainy seasons, so skin usually needs less product, not more. A gentle face wash, a thin moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and about half a pea-sized night cream in the monsoon suit most people.
facts: Kochi has a hot, humid coastal climate
The southwest monsoon brings heavy rain from June to September
Northeast monsoon showers follow in October and November
December to February is a little less humid
